roster-priority.as_of: Current: house Q&A, Chaos season (28-29 Jun 2026, postdates the 25/06/2026 patch anchor). The Sep 2025 farm chart and Nov 2023 doctrine claims are earlier-season history only, cross-check both against current meta before acting on them.

meta-history.title: Season meta history
meta-history.as_of: Four distinct dated snapshots forming a timeline, not one current list: S21 (24 Oct 2024), a 30 Jun 2025 board, a 29 Sep 2025 board, and a Chaos-season 30 Jun 2026 board.
meta-history.body:
StarBurst's tier boards give a rough season-by-season read on what's considered strong. Season 21 (24 Oct 2024) put Sunward Phalanx, Iron Reapers, Queen's Knights, ISG, Xuanji Heavy Cavalry and a handful of others at the top tier. A 30 Jun 2025 "Meta Units - ATK" board listed Stalwarts, Paladins, ISG, Spear Sergeants, Wuwei Mansion Guard, MMA/Fortebraccio, Dagger-axe Lancers, Yeomen, Companion Cavalry and Myrmillones. A later 29 Sep 2025 "current meta" board named Condottier Guards, Halberdiers, Prefecture Guards, Demesne Arbalists/MMA, Spear Sergeants, Paladins, ISG, IPG, Stalwarts/Shieldmaidens, Spartan Chosen, Orochi Samurai, Sunward Phalanx, Iron Reapers and Winged Hussars, several still flagged TBD on the board itself. {1}

The freshest snapshot: a 30 Jun 2026 pass through that same recurring "Meta Units - ATK" board recorded it as Stalwarts, ISG, Claymores, Zealot, Berserkers, Paladins, IPG, Zykalian Militia, Yorkist Household Knights, Dagger-axe Lancers, Fortebraccio and Lancastrian Billmen. Read this as the newest dated snapshot of the three above, not a conflicting list - the three are the same recurring board at different points in time. {2}
